svg.text: Left: synchronous request handlers (tRPC, route handlers). Right: durable Inngest functions. They never call each other —

text.font-family: Excalifont3, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: they meet only in the data stores in the middle, including the event queue.

svg.text: * duplicated external entity (drawn twice to avoid crossing lines). Every process also appends to the ops logs — guard_event, sandbox_event, throttle_window, memory_usage, email_usage — not drawn.

text.font-family: Excalifont3, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: Arrow direction = direction of data. Double-headed arrows read and write.

text.font-family: Excalifont3, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: P9 reads the user, project, message and export rows (D1–D3) and counts sends in email_usage. P3 and P7 only queue the notify/send event.
